For us, Q2 was particularly important because this was the quarter when we had our annual 
Ather Community Day 2026 and where we launched a whole bunch of things from our 
ecosystem to software to obviously, the new product, Konarc. Let's start with some of the 
launches we did in this ACD. ACD overall has become a pretty landmark event for us. 
It's grown from its humble origins of about 600, 700 owners who came in, in 2023 to almost 
6,000 people who got together in Bangalore this year. Fantastic coverage, many, many, many 
viral moments, and a lot of attention that it's helped bring to the brand and established its equity 
across the country. 
 
Some of the important things that launched in this ACD were starting with Ather TrueHealth. 
This is a comprehensive health report of a scooter, where we basically started showing the health 
of different components like the battery, brakes, belts, dashboard, motor, etcetera, on your 
mobile app. 
So you can just go to your mobile app, click a button and see the health of different components, 
which is quite pioneering in our industry. And we convert all of that into a simple health score. 
Essentially, we want to -- the idea here is we want to give EV owners a lot of confidence and 
comfort that how their EV is performing even after years of usage. 
 
And we took it one step forward by starting -- we have started to show with estimated resale 
value for scooters that have crossed 3 years of ownership. The intention, again, is not at this 
point to establish a business channel, but to again give EV owners a lot of conviction that they've 
made the right choice by going to electric, and their vehicles continue to retain a lot of value. 
 
The second thing that we announced was Ather Node, which is a infrastructure product that 
enables EV charging in apartments. It's a really smart system that comes with automatic queuing, 
smart load management. 
It draws power from common loads instead of individual houses, freeing up a lot of complicated 
infrastructure that the homeowners otherwise would need to do, comes with customized billing 
and is very cost effective. Ather Node is getting industrialized right now and will commence 
operations -- commence deployment in the next few months as we are onboarding our first few 
set of partners. 
 
Third big thing was Ather Bedrock, which is our fifth-generation battery packs with enhanced 
safety and much longer warranty periods. These are fairly well-developed battery packs, which 
come with real-time micro leak detection. They come with cell balancing that is almost 5x faster 
than previous generation and are the first battery packs from Ather that come with 10 years or 1 
lakh kilometer warranties with a 70% performance guarantee. These batteries have already gone 
live across the entire portfolio from 450, Rizta and Konarc. 
 
And obviously, the big launch for ACD underpinning all of it this year was Konarc, our 
mainstream product going live this year. Konarc, we decided to focus a lot of -- a lot in this 
product on the fundamentals of scooters in India. So this is our first scooter that's come with 14-
inch front wheels. It's come with one of the longest rear suspensions in the country for scooters.

proprietary advanced electronic braking system, which helps -- which is a remarkable 
improvement over CBS and reduces the stopping distance substantially even on slippery roads.

there are still many small segments that remain, and we will focus on them also.

probably covered the bulk of the territory already. And over the next 12 to 18 months, as different 
variants -- over the next -- sorry, a couple of quarters, as the different versions of Konarc keep 
hitting the market, we believe our TAM will continue to expand.

about 34% year-on-year. So very healthy growth, obviously.

stronger growth. Ather inquiries were up even more at about 109%, crossing 10 lakh inquiries 
for Q2 FY27. And preorders were up at about 108% year-on-year, hitting about 1.8 lakh 
preorders in Q2 FY27.

Wholesale volume grew from 65,000 units same time last year to 93,000 units in Q2, 42% 
growth year-on-year. This has been enabled by a very healthy ramp-up of our capacity,

honestly gone parabolic, as you can see in our presentation that we have shared online. Preorders 
have also risen up quite a lot. And though we have produced 33,000 units average last quarter, 
on current demand trajectory from the current stores, our team's internal estimate is that we have 
roughly about 20,000 units per month of unrealized retail that we are not tapping into yet. 
 
Now to solve this, Hosur, which is already at its tether's end, it's at 35,000 per month capacity. 
And AURIC Phase 1, which is going live and will finish complete installation of its capex by 
Q4 FY27, adds an incremental 42,000 units, which means a net capacity of 77,000 units per 
month. But if current demand is already in 50,000 to 60,000 units zip code, 77,000 units 
obviously does not leave a lot of headroom to grow. So this is a question that we've been 
pondering for the last few months. 
 
What we've decided to do, and we have just taken Board approval a few hours ago, is we decided 
to enhance capacity in both Hosur and AURIC Phase 1 in the coming months itself with Hosur 
capacity expansion happening right away, an incremental 6,000 units per month capacity that 
will go live this quarter -- later this quarter.

lakh units, which is where we were -- we would have been by, let's say, middle of next year to 
11.4 lakh units by Q2 FY28. 
 
So this is an important jump and an important near-term jump, I would say, that our teams have 
decided to focus on, giving us hopefully enough headroom to grow for the next couple of years 
as Konarc hopefully drives a lot more growth across the country for us. I know the last few 
months have been quite tight for us with demand far outstripping supply. But with all this 
capacity expansion finally is starting to yield through, I'm very excited about the next few 
months as we start seeing results of all of this in the top line.

- essentially opened up a new lever for us in the business, and it's improved margins by 2.7% in 
Q2. Netting out Q2 FY27 AGM at 24%, which is a 1.6% improvement over Q1 FY27, I think 
roughly, yes.

with EBITDA showing a 1,450 bps improvement year-on-year, from minus 9.6% in Q2 FY26
